claim-2-6.formal_statement:
theorem AngelDevil.reducedJourney_allowed (p : Nat) (D : DevilStrategy) (h : List Point)
    (ha : Allowed p (niceReduction p D) h) : Allowed p D (reducedJourney p h)  := by sorry

theorem-2-4.formal_statement:
theorem AngelDevil.confinement_to_nice (p N : Nat) (D : DevilStrategy)
    (hc : ∀ A n, (∀ m, m < n →
      Jump p (current (play A D m)) (current (play A D (m+1))) ∧
      some (current (play A D (m+1))) ∉ (play A D (m+1)).burned) →
      InBox N (current (play A D n))) : NiceCanConfine p N  := by sorry

uniform-confinement.formal_statement:
theorem AngelDevil.uniform_confinement (p : Nat) (hp : 0 < p)
    (h : ¬ AngelWins p) : ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ ∃ D : DevilStrategy,
    ∀ A n, (∀ m, m < n →
      Jump p (current (play A D m)) (current (play A D (m+1))) ∧
      some (current (play A D (m+1))) ∉ (play A D (m+1)).burned) →
      InBox N (current (play A D n)) := by sorry
